jobs.description:
Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. Since we launched Mercury in 2019, our customer base has grown to over 300,000 startups and small businesses from all around the world. This turns out to be a pretty wild endeavor, so we’re looking to bring someone smart onto our Customer Support team to help us out.

As a member of our Customer Support team, you’ll make sure our users are charmed by warmth and competence when they have questions or needs that aren’t being met by our product. You’ll radiate intelligence while exercising your best human qualities, like compassion and empathy, even in the face of frustration.

You’ll need to understand how our product works in detail. Banking* has a lot of moving pieces, so this is harder than it might seem. Finding efficient, elegant solutions for problems stemming from the oft-convoluted U.S. financial system isn’t always easy, but if you’re good at your job, our users will never know it.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

What You’ll Do:

- Answer user questions over chat, email, and phone

- Handle user account requests, including application processing, card disputes, missing payments, card shipments, and a whole lot more

- Teach customers how to use our product (hopefully most of it is self-explanatory), and translate user confusion into product suggestions

- Identify the systemic flaws that lead to user problems

- Work with our engineering team to find and squash bugs

- Communicate our users' needs to our partner banks and work with them to improve their products and processes

- Write help articles and FAQs

- Learn our internal tools and figure out how to improve them

- Put in place processes to make your job more efficient

- Help with other compliance and customer tasks

- Create and sustain warm relationships with our users

- Help build out the customer support and ops infrastructure at Mercury

What You Bring:

- Have 2+ years of experience in a Customer Experience / Customer Support role

- Consistently exercise empathy

- Always seek to answer the question behind the question

- Understand how to translate complex terminology into clear, human user communication

- Enjoy thinking about how to automate as much of your job as possible

- Keep a clean, ordered inbox

- Stay calm and collected while working on ten things at once

- Feel confident talking with startup folks in person, over chat, or on the phone

- Use creativity while working within difficult constraints

- Show kindness in the face of unpleasantness (our customers generally are really great, but they can get passionate when it comes to their businesses)

Would be nice if you:

- Have experience working in retail branch banking

- Are passionate about uncovering customer needs

- Enjoy solving customer problems and proactively offering solutions to unmet needs

Schedule Information:

- Required: be available to work at least one weekend day per 5 day shift

- We are currently hiring for multiple shifts. Openings will be covered early in the interview process

- Your working schedule will be fixed - this is long-term commitment, not a rotating shift

All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

jobs.description:
Merchant Operations at Polar

Merchant Operations at Polar is about delivering an exceptional merchant experience while building the processes, tooling and automation that allow us to scale. As we rethink how software companies monetize their products, we help merchants navigate the complexities of global payments, billing and financial workflows.

Polar sits in the critical path of our merchants' businesses, where reliability, responsiveness and sound judgment matter deeply. We're looking for people who enjoy solving complex problems, understanding how products work and collaborating closely with Product and Engineering to turn merchant insights into meaningful improvements.

We're a small, fast-moving team where there's plenty of room to take ownership, challenge how things are done and make a meaningful impact. We value people who look beyond individual problems, spot opportunities to improve how we work and help build the systems and experiences that make Polar better as we scale.

More about Polar and how we work.

Role & responsibilities: What you will do

As a Merchant Support Specialist, you'll be on the front lines helping merchants and customers succeed with Polar. You'll troubleshoot issues, answer questions, and work closely with Product and Engineering to improve the merchant experience.

As a small and fast-moving team, we’re looking for someone who wants to do more than resolve individual support requests. You’ll be close to the product and the people using it, identifying friction, spotting opportunities for improvement, and helping build the processes, tooling, and automation that allow Merchant Operations to scale alongside Polar.

You’ll work with the team to

-
Own merchant and customer inquiries end-to-end across email, chat, and Slack, ensuring issues are understood, prioritized and driven to resolution.

-
Investigate and troubleshoot issues across payments, payouts, subscriptions, checkout and the merchant dashboard, building a deep understanding of how Polar works.

-
Help merchants successfully onboard, navigate the platform, and understand the operational and financial workflows involved in using Polar as their Merchant of Record.

-
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to reproduce bugs, uncover root causes, and turn merchant feedback into meaningful product improvements.

-
Identify recurring support trends, proactively identifying recurring friction and opportunities to improve the Help Center, documentation, product, and internal processes.

-
 Exercise sound judgment in prioritizing and escalating complex technical, payment, and account issues, balancing urgency, merchant impact, and operational risk.

-
Maintain a high bar for customer experience by providing thoughtful, accurate, and timely support.

-
Contribute to operational improvements that help us scale support without sacrificing quality.

What we’re looking for

We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, resourceful, and enjoys getting to the bottom of complex problems. You're comfortable working across multiple tools, can explain complex topics clearly, and care about delivering an excellent customer experience while balancing efficiency with attention to detail.

Skills & Experience

-
2+ years of experience in customer support, merchant support, or customer success, preferably in SaaS, fintech, or payments.

-
Excellent written communication skills with a customer-first mindset.

-
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.

-
Experience working with support platforms such as Plain, Zendesk, Intercom, or similar.

-
Ability to independently prioritize and manage multiple conversations while maintaining attention to detail.

-
Comfortable collaborating with Product and Engineering teams to resolve customer issues.

-
Familiarity with payments, subscriptions, or Merchant of Record platforms is a plus.

About Lyra Health

Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

About the Role

The Client Support Specialist serves as the critical first point of contact for Lyra clients seeking high-quality mental health care. This is a vital, client-facing role that supports individuals beginning their care journey.

Key responsibilities include conducting needs assessments, connecting clients to appropriate care, performing risk triage and escalation to our clinical teams, and answering benefit, product, and technical questions. Lyra provides extensive training on how to support our clients and meet them where they are in their care journey.

Above all, this team member is committed to supporting each client with confidence and compassion. This is a high-volume, performance-driven contact center environment where proficiency in managing all inbound channels-calls, emails and chats is essential.

Must be able to work one of the following shifts:
Monday - Friday 7:30pm - 4:00am PT

Tuesday - Saturday 7:30pm - 4:00am PT

Sunday - Thursday 7:30pm - 4:00am PT
Tuesday - Saturday 9pm - 5:30am PT

Sunday - Thursday 9pm - 5:30am PT

Responsibilities

-
Demonstrate strong time management skills and flexibility in fielding the unexpected throughout the workday

-
Conduct needs assessment and educate clients about Lyra’s services and benefit offerings

-
Prioritize client safety and wellbeing, with an ability to recognize potential safety concerns and escalate to ensure clients receive an appropriate level of support

-
Engage in feedback and frequent self-assessment of strengths and areas for growth

-
Work well in a structured team environment

-
Demonstrate flexibility with shift changes.

-
Excellent communication skills: written and verbal

-
Technical: You easily navigate through Customer Relationship Management tools.

-
Ability to handle a high volume workload either through chat, email or phones and the ability to pivot between servicing channels as needed

Qualifications

Minimum 1 year of direct experience in a customer support, customer service, or high-touch service role.

-
Demonstrate exceptional writing skills and the ability to provide information in a clear and concise manner while conveying a warm and friendly tone

-
Experience with Zendesk, Salesforce, and/or Chat tools; otherwise you pride yourself on picking up new tools/systems quickly.

This role requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as part of our regular coverage schedule.

Experience working remotely is a plus.

jobs.description:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated and high-performing Field Specialist to join our team in New Zealand, supporting the maintenance and performance of Halter’s on-farm hardware infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring our systems are operating efficiently, resolving technical issues quickly, and helping to refine and improve the reliability of our hardware across our customer network.

Note this role is Tasman/Marlborough based with regular NZ travel.

This is a hands-on position that requires strong technical ability, problem-solving skills, and a proactive approach to field operations. You may find yourself maintaining and upgrading infrastructure one day and deploying new equipment on-farm the next. You’ll be the go-to person for ensuring everything runs smoothly, delivering exceptional service and support to our customers. As a Field Specialist, you’ll work closely with our hardware, product, and customer success teams, ensuring effective collaboration and a strong feedback loop between the field and our Auckland HQ.This role offers the opportunity to make a real impact in transforming New Zealand’s dairy and livestock industry through world-class agri-tech innovation.

What your day could look like

-
Infrastructure Maintenance: Oversee the upkeep and repair of Halter’s infrastructure to ensure seamless operations.

-
Hardware Diagnosis: Diagnose any issues with our hardware and feed this information back to the relevant team.

-
Versatility: Ability to transition smoothly between tasks, from repairing and upgrading infrastructure to delivering towers and collars as needed.

-
Deployment Support: Provide critical on-site support during farm deployments if needed, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring successful installations.

-
On-call: Be part of the global on-call roster to support tower-related incidents and proactively find solutions in a timely manner.

-
Collaboration: Work closely across all of the Halter teams to ensure alignment and successful customer outcomes.

-
Problem-Solving: Address and resolve technical challenges promptly and effectively, ensuring minimal disruption to farm operations.

-
Adaptability: Be prepared to manage a variety of tasks, often simultaneously, to meet the dynamic needs of the role.

-
Data Analysis: Ability to collect, interpret, and analyse data from our hardware, optimise processes, and inform decision-making. You'll ensure that actionable insights are extracted to improve operational efficiency and resolve issues proactively. Development and management of a maintenance system for our NZ market.

-
Travel: travel within the South Island region + some NZ wide travel will be required.

Who are we looking for

-
Practical, hands-on experience with tools, electrical work, construction, networking, or equipment fitting is a must!

-
Go-Getter Attitude: A proactive approach, with a willingness to tackle challenges head-on and figure things out on the go.

-
Handiness: Practical skills and resourcefulness, with the ability to handle a wide range of tasks even without specific technical training.

-
Time management skills: Ability to manage your own time so that tasks are completed on schedule.

-
Team-Oriented Approach: Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with colleagues across different locations.

-
Commitment to Excellence: A dedication to providing the highest quality service, ensuring that Halter’s infrastructure is always operating at its best.

-
Willingness to travel: Spontaneous & planned travel will be included in this role. You might be 3 or 4 days on the road per week. You may also be 3 nights away from home per week.

Bonus Qualifications (These are not mandatory for you to apply)

-
Agriculture Experience (Preferred): While not mandatory, experience in the agriculture sector would be highly beneficial.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

-
Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

-
Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

-
You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

-
This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

Company Overview

LevelUp is a specialist agency that provides outsourcing solutions to agencies, software vendors, and website owners. The Customer Success Specialist is a key member of our team, responsible for managing the commercial execution and retention of high-volume accounts. Working in North America Central Time, the specialist will collaborate closely with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to provide a unified and exceptional customer experience. - Downgrade Management: Assess, process, and accurately execute customer downgrade requests in alignment with policy, ensuring retention risks are identified, properly documented, and addressed through appropriate internal escalation or value-based conversations.

About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

About the team

The Internal Communications team exists to:

-
Drive alignment to the company vision and strategy, so every employee has a clear understanding of our priorities, why they're important, and how their work impacts our success

-
Build trust and connection, so employees are engaged as true advocates of the business; feel they have a clear voice and are listened to; and are equipped to deliver outstanding work through periods of transformational change, including the integration of Mollie and GoCardless

-
Scale and iterate on our fantastic culture, so the combination of Mollie and GoCardless creates an irresistible place to work, with a strong sense of belonging.

What excites you:

-
Help lead the day-to-day planning and output of the Internal Comms team; this includes ensuring we execute against projects, whilst keeping the momentum going with our continuous 'drumbeat' of regular communications

-
Develop communication plans to support the GoCardless and Mollie integration, helping colleagues across both businesses understand what's changing, why it matters, and what it means for them; building confidence as we come together

-
Be the primary owner of our Town Hall sessions, from shaping the agenda and briefing leaders and speakers to producing content, delivering the sessions and creating and sharing follow-up materials, so each one helps employees across the business understand where we're heading, and why

-
Devise and execute communication plans (for example, to roll out our engagement survey, business transformation, or to celebrate the launch of a new product) which deliver clear, measurable outcomes

-
Build connections to become a trusted adviser to stakeholders around the business to advise them on achieving their communications goals

-
Co-manage our communications channels, including our intranet, Slack, and email tool, and help shape how these channels continually develop and help us to show up across both GoCardless and Mollie

-
Host and measure regular listening sessions with employees from all of our locations, including colleagues joining us through Mollie, to help inform our work and identify opportunities for improvement and impact.

There's endless opportunity to have an impact in this role. The team sits at the heart of the business, helping to curate, contextualise, and build a shared understanding of the business' priorities, and the progress we're making. The integration is a huge opportunity for our team, meaning this is a demanding but very fulfilling time to join us. You should be proactive, ultimately keeping your 'finger on the pulse' of the business to identify opportunities for internal comms to strengthen execution against our mission.

-
Experience in a busy internal communications team or function

-
Ability to originate and execute strategic internal communications plans; tactically deliver them; and measure results

-
Experience taking the lead on internal communications aligned to various business transformation projects, with involvement 'end to end'; experience of M&A or integration communications is a real plus

-
Confidently build relationships with stakeholders (at all levels), and other employees, so they trust us as experts

-
Exceptional writing ability; you're unfazed by jargon and can easily transform complexity into something compelling and easy to understand, all in our authoritative and friendly tone of voice

-
An omnichannel mindset; you know how to get the very best out of various channels and platforms, from straightforward emails through to Slack, Zoom, face to face, intranet and more; you're keen to explore new technologies that enhance what we do - such as AI

-
You excel at, and are unfazed by, being 'hands on' to get things done, often having to prioritise multiple tasks at once. As a small team, we all chip in to deliver collective results

-
Ideally, experience handling logistics and communications for large company events, before, during and after.

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point (€2060 - €2580 (gross)) of the pay range until performance can be assessed in the role. - Understanding existing processes and re-designing controls to meet current and future business needs

- Working with the Regulatory team to ensure audits are completed successfully, including explaining our first-line controls to auditors and regulators

About this role

In this role, you'll have significant ownership of your work, make impactful decisions daily, and report directly to the founders. This is a full-time remote position open to candidates in all timezones.

Support is the foundation of everything we do. Our apps have consistently maintained high ratings on the Shopify App Store because our support team genuinely cares about helping merchants succeed. - Somone who fixes the process while you’re fixing the ticket.

- Someone who's comfortable diving into technical issues and can confidently support merchants over email and through clear, helpful video recordings.

- An eye for patterns and the ability to turn merchant feedback into actionable insights for our product and engineering teams.

- The ability to prioritize effectively. You can assess what's urgent, what's important, and what can wait, especially when everything feels like it needs attention.

- Comfort with change. You stay calm when the product evolves and enjoy picking up new knowledge as you go.

- A team-first mindset. You jump in to support others, document what you've learned, and share what's working so we can all move faster together.

- Strong communication skills, especially in writing. You know how to keep things clear, friendly, and easy to follow, whether you're talking to a merchant or a teammate.

- Natural troubleshooting instincts. You enjoy working on tricky issues and figuring out what's actually going on, not just treating the symptoms.

- Great attention to detail. You care about getting the small things right, because they add up to a better experience.

- A curious mind. You're always learning, always testing, always a few steps ahead.

- The ability to explain complex ideas in a simple way, especially for merchants who aren't technical.

Experience

- Previous experience in technical support at a SaaS or tech company

- Familiarity with HelpScout or other ticketing systems

- Hands-on knowledge of front-end development (HTML, CSS, browser dev tools)

- Working understanding of REST APIs and common data formats like JSON or XML

- Comfort with debugging using Chrome DevTools, especially for browser or front-end issues

- Knowledge of how HTTP and DNS work

- Experience reading API documentation and troubleshooting third-party integrations or custom app setups

- Some exposure to GraphQL APIs

Bonus experience

- Shopify theme development and Liquid: Knowing how themes interact with app blocks, line item properties, and cart/checkout logic helps when diagnosing visual or UX issues on merchant stores.

- Understanding of Shopify's admin and storefront APIs: Familiarity with how Shopify's APIs behave (especially in headless or custom setups) can be useful when troubleshooting sync issues, metafields, or app-triggered updates.

Beyond expertise, success in this role means embodying 3 core values

- Resourcefulness: You're relentlessly resourceful and always find ways to achieve the highest standards of quality. You know where to look and whom to consult when faced with challenges.

- Ownership: You take complete ownership and pride in your work. This means deeply understanding our existing and prospective merchants, as well as our product.

- Communication: You're clear, thoughtful, and intentional in how you communicate with both merchants and teammates. You surface issues early, share relevant context, and keep things moving without needing constant follow-up.

We're async by default

If you've ever ended a day of back-to-back meetings wondering when you were supposed to get any actual work done, we get it. We've been there. We've built a culture that protects time, encourages focus, and trusts you to do great work without constant check-ins.

We meet once a week for 30 min on Mondays. The rest of the time, we default to async: clear Slack threads, thoughtful Looms, and shared docs.

Perks & compensation

- Competitive salary + annual pay increases.

- $1,000 annual workspace stipend for laptop, headphones, or that standing desk you've been eyeing.

- Flexible hours. Work when you're most productive. We just ask for ~4 hours of overlap with Eastern Time (9 am to 5 pm EST).

- Flexible vacation policy. Take the time you need, no arbitrary caps.

- Conversation with the co-founders (30 min): Meet Lichen (CEO) and Basil (CTO). We'll talk about projects you've worked on, how you approach support and problem-solving, and what kind of work energizes you.

- Paid take-home assignment: We'll send you a real-life merchant scenario to work through and pay you $100 USD for your time.

- Reference chats: We'll speak with two people you've worked with to understand your collaboration style and strengths.

- Offer: If it's a match, we move quickly, answer any final questions, and welcome you to the team.

About Replika
In 2017, no one knew what AI was supposed to be. We built the world's first consumer AI app. Two million people showed up in two months. Today it's over 40 million, and the thing they keep telling us hasn't changed: it helped. It made their life better, steadier, a little less alone.
Most AI is built for tasks, not for people. It gives you answers, but it doesn't care what you do with them. AI doesn't just need intelligence. It needs intention. Because the real question isn't just what AI can do. It's what AI is for.
When the world's leading researchers wanted to understand whether AI could actually change someone's life, they studied Replika, because there was nothing else to study. What they found at Stanford, at Harvard, across years of research, was that Replika doesn't replace human connection. It deepens it. People become more social, more confident, more themselves. Not in theory. In their actual lives.
Every major AI company talks about their mission for humanity. None of them has ever clearly said what they're trying to do for a single person. We will. We want to help you flourish in real life. Not become a better version of yourself, just more yourself. Strong relationships. Better health. Meaning. Momentum. A life that feels worth living while you're living it.
We're building the kind of AI that follows up. That knows the people in your life and nudges you to reach out when it matters. That sends you a poem, just because. The goal is conversations that lead somewhere real. Maybe it's a text you send to a long lost friend. A hobby you pick up again. A moment you show up for yourself.
Everyone else is building AI that thinks. We're building AI that cares.

About this role
Millions of people have already met Replika: free users who haven't upgraded yet, subscribers who've lapsed, and people who signed up years ago and drifted away. Almost none of them hear from us in a way that's worth opening. That's the biggest untapped channel we have, and you'll own it.
You'll build our lifecycle program from the ground up. Email first, then in-app messages, push and any other channel that gets the right message to the right person at the right moment. Onboarding, free-to-paid conversion, renewals, win-back, product launches. The goal is revenue and retention, not open rates.
This is a hands-on role. You'll help set the lifecycle strategy and build it yourself: the segments, the flows, the copy, the tests and the reporting.

- Build the core lifecycle flows: onboarding, free-to-paid conversion, intro offers ending, renewals, cancellation saves and win-back.

- Reactivate our base. Plan and run campaigns to lapsed users and our long-dormant email list, cleanly and within consent.

- Segment and personalize with product and subscription data, so each person gets the message that fits where they are.

- Hands-on lifecycle or CRM experience at a consumer subscription app, with revenue results you can show.

- You've built flows yourself in a modern messaging platform like Braze, Customer.io, Iterable or Klaviyo.

- Strong with data. You build your own segments and read your own results without waiting for an analyst.

- You shape the strategy and do the implementation yourself.

Bonus Points
- In-app messaging and push experience on iOS and Android.

- Deliverability experience: domain reputation, warming, and bringing a large dormant list back safely.

- You've worked on a product where trust and tone really matter.

What You’ll Get

Talkdesk competes in a market where the quality of execution separates companies that grow efficiently from those that spend more to get the same result. You sit inside the Marketing team, with close partnerships across Sales and RevOps. The marketers running campaigns, events, and account-based programs are your primary stakeholders. When the system works, their work converts.

In practice, that means owning the full operational surface of marketing technology: administering and continuously improving the tools that make up our GTM stack, building and maintaining the integrations that keep data moving cleanly between systems, designing the orchestrations that automate account and contact engagement, ensuring the enrichment and data integrity standards that make every downstream decision reliable. This is an interdependent system, and this person keeps it running as a coherent, high-performing whole.

What You'll Own

- Account-Based Marketing Orchestration: Serve as the technical owner of our ABM orchestration layer. Translate signals from our intent platform into automated, sequenced actions across our marketing automation platform and CRM, working closely with campaign and field marketing teams to ensure the right programs reach the right accounts at the right moment. Getting this infrastructure right is one of the highest-impact contributions this role makes to the business.

- Marketing Technology Foundation: Own the day-to-day health of our martech systems and the workflows, API calls, integrations, and syncs that connect them to keep prospect data moving accurately through the funnel. When something breaks or underperforms, you diagnose it, fix it, and document the resolution so it does not recur.

- Agentic AI Workflow Engineering: Design and build automated workflows that use AI capabilities to evaluate qualitative signals, such as demo request notes, intent activity, and unstructured form inputs, alongside firmographic data to produce dynamic lead scores and routing decisions. You write the API calls, design the orchestration logic, test against edge cases, and iterate based on conversion outcomes. Experience shipping something to production is the bar.

- Enrichment and Insights: Build and manage the workflows that construct a complete, account-level intelligence profile from the moment a prospect engages. That means aggregating first-party behavioral signals, third-party intent data, firmographic context, and web research into a unified view that captures not just the individual contact but the broader buying committee: who across the account is engaging, with what content, and what their activity suggests about organizational priorities and pain points. That intelligence surfaces in the systems where sales and marketing work, so every follow-up is informed, relevant, and timed to the account's buying journey.

- System Documentation and Enablement: Every workflow you build or modify gets documented: field mapping dictionaries, AI orchestration logic, routing rule change logs. Beyond documentation, you actively invest in making the marketing team more self-sufficient, building self-service reporting and dashboards that allow marketers to check campaign performance, list quality, or lead status independently, and creating resources that allow colleagues to troubleshoot routine tasks and leverage AI tools without filing a request. An empowered marketing team operates with greater speed and confidence, and this role contributes meaningfully to that outcome.

Who You Are

You operate with a high degree of autonomy. You are embedded in the relevant standups, attentive to system performance, and typically ahead of issues before they surface as escalations. Your manager will set context and priorities; the execution is yours to own.

You are invested in the success of the Marketing team. You understand that the campaigns, events, and programs your colleagues execute are only as effective as the systems that support them. Leads from a field event that go unrouted, an ABM sequence that executes against incomplete data, or a high-intent inbound request that experiences significant delay before reaching an SDR all represent measurable pipeline impact. You approach your work with that accountability in mind.

You are technically strong and collaborative by nature. Marketers, Sales and RevOps are close partners. You understand their workflows well enough to anticipate where system gaps will affect their work, and communicate clearly when something is broken, when it is fixed, and why. Strong cross-functional relationships are central to this role.

You see the work through to completion. You build, test, document, and close the loop. When something you own regresses, you identify it first.

Required

- 3 to 5 years in B2B SaaS Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, or a systems-adjacent role

- Demonstrated ability to build and deploy an automated workflow that calls external APIs, whether webhooks, REST APIs, or LLM endpoints, in a production environment

- Native fluency in B2B funnel mechanics: MQL definitions, lifecycle stage transitions, opportunity lifecycles, and attribution models

Strong Signal

How We'll Measure Success

The through-line across all of it is pipeline efficiency: more of the right prospects converting into pipeline from the programs already running, with less manual intervention and less fallout.

30 days: Full audit of marketing automation-to-CRM field mapping is complete, ownership of inbound routing rules is established, and current ABM workflow patterns are mapped to identify key automation opportunities.

ABM orchestration operates as a reliable service layer that campaign and field marketers can brief and trust to execute. Marketing colleagues actively leverage self-service tools and AI workflows independently.

At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Care Coordinator to join our Referral Management team. This role would be responsible for supporting patients throughout their care journey, monitoring patient engagement, identifying potential barriers to care, and coordinating with Talkspace providers and facilities when patients require additional support or a transition to a higher level of care. We are looking for someone who is highly organized, patient-focused, proactive, comfortable managing multiple patients and priorities, and is passionate about making a meaningful impact and bringing their talents into a “for purpose” space. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based on Eastern or Central time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What You’ll Do

- Patient Support & Activation

- Monitor patient lead-up requirements and paperwork to help ensure patients are prepared for their first appointment.

- Follow up on outstanding patient requirements and identify barriers that may prevent timely activation.

- Ensure patient accounts are activated and ready for care in accordance with established workflows.

- Provide patients with clear information regarding next steps, appointments, and care coordination processes.

- Respond to patient questions and concerns and ensure appropriate follow-through.

- Patient Engagement & Care Journey

- Monitor patients throughout their initial care journey and support continued engagement with care.

- Conduct outreach and follow-up activities to monitor patient engagement during the first 30 days of care.

- Identify patients who may be at risk of disengagement and take appropriate action to support continued participation in care.

- Follow up on missed appointments and coordinate with appropriate internal teams to address barriers to care.

- Monitor and help ensure patients are not incorrectly billed for missed first appointments by following established processes and escalating issues as needed.

- Maintain accurate and timely documentation of patient outreach, engagement, and follow-up activities.

- Escalation & Step-Up in Care

- Support the identification and coordination of patients who may require escalation or transition to a higher level of care.

- Coordinate with Talkspace providers and patients to facilitate a safe and smooth transition back to an appropriate UHS facility when additional or higher-level care is needed.

- Work with internal stakeholders to identify the appropriate UHS facility based on the patient's needs and circumstances.

- Contact UHS facilities to coordinate scheduling and facilitate the transition of care.

- Communicate relevant information, next steps, and expectations clearly to patients, providers, and facility stakeholders.

- Track outstanding transition activities and ensure timely follow-through through completion.

- Escalate complex patient, scheduling, or operational issues to the Care Coordinator Manager or appropriate clinical team members.

- Team Collaboration

- Work closely with Care Coordinators, Care Coordinator Managers, providers, and internal operational teams to support patient needs.

- Collaborate with Talkspace providers and UHS facility partners to facilitate patient access and continuity of care.

- Communicate patient engagement trends, barriers, and operational issues to appropriate team members.

- Follow established workflows and contribute feedback and recommendations to improve patient support and care coordination processes.

- Participate in team meetings, training, and ongoing process improvement initiatives.

- Documentation & Quality

- Maintain accurate, complete, and timely documentation of patient outreach, activation, engagement, and care transitions.

- Follow established policies, procedures, and workflows related to patient communication, care coordination, and escalation.

- Protect patient confidentiality and handle sensitive patient information in accordance with applicable privacy and compliance requirements.

- Support team performance and quality goals by completing assigned outreach and follow-up activities within established timelines.

- Identify recurring barriers or issues impacting patient engagement and communicate opportunities for improvement to leadership.

- Other Responsibilities

- Performs other related duties as assigned.

- Provides operational and patient support to the Care Coordination team as needed.

About You

- High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor's degree in healthcare, social services, business, or a related field preferred.

- 1–2 years of experience in care coordination, patient support, customer support, or case management.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with patients, providers, and facility stakeholders.

- Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple patients, tasks, and competing priorities.

- Ability to work independently while following established processes and escalating issues appropriately.

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate documentation and follow-through.

- Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to identify barriers and determine appropriate next steps.

- Ability to handle sensitive patient interactions with professionalism, empathy, and discretion.

- Comfortable working with technology and navigating multiple systems and platforms.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment and adapting to changing priorities.

Bonus Points

- Experience working directly with patients or members in a healthcare or service-oriented environment preferred.

- Experience with healthcare, behavioral health, telehealth, or provider networks preferred.

- Familiarity with patient engagement, care transitions, or coordination between levels of care preferred.

Benefits

- Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

- Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA

- 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 4%

- Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.

- Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care

- PTO and Remote First Environment

- Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events

- Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The hourly range for this role is between $20 - $25/hr. Within the range, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

About the role

Hi, my name is Caitlin, Senior Manager, Technical Support at Customer.io, and I'm looking for an Email Deliverability Specialist to join our deliverability program within Technical Support. You'll help customers reach the inbox by diagnosing sending issues, advising on best practices, and guiding senders through an email ecosystem that keeps changing.

You'll be one of several deliverability experts on a team that shares knowledge across Technical Support, so your work reaches well beyond your own queue. You'll partner with Customer Success, Technical Support, and Engineering: taking customer calls, equipping CSMs for customer conversations, working through complex technical cases alongside Engineering, and turning what you see in tickets into documentation, training, and better processes.

You'll thrive here if you think about the health of the whole program, enjoy improving how work gets done, and are equally comfortable digging into a detailed case and having a direct conversation with a customer about acceptable use.

What we value

Empathy and curiosity: You approach every customer with patience and a desire to dig deeper, especially when a conversation gets uncomfortable.

Clarity: You explain complex technical concepts simply and help others do the same.

Collaboration: You build strong partnerships across Support, Customer Success, and Engineering, and you treat customer outcomes as a shared goal.

Thinking at scale: You look at how we do things today and see what could work better for the whole organization, then you help make it happen.

Continuous learning: You stay ahead of evolving standards and see change as a chance to improve how we work.

What you'll do

- Act as a trusted deliverability advisor to customers, handling complex cases through to full resolution and leading customer calls when a conversation needs it

- Audit sender setup and monitor reputation across IPs and domains, using authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and BIMI, DNS configuration, and provider tools like Google Postmaster Tools, Yahoo Sender Hub, and Microsoft SNDS to diagnose blocklists, spam traps, and engagement drops

- Work through highly technical issues with Engineering, taking ownership of the investigation first and sharing trends from customer cases with Product and Engineering

- Identify acceptable use policy violations and spam complaints, hold clear and direct conversations with customers about compliance, and keep up with evolving standards (Gmail and Yahoo sender requirements, CAN-SPAM, GDPR)

- 2-4 years of experience in email deliverability at a mid-size or large ESP, B2B SaaS company, or marketing automation platform, with exposure to deliverability at scale

- Deep understanding of email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI) and infrastructure (SMTP, MTAs, DNS), with the technical comfort to work through complex issues with Engineering

- Proficiency with provider data feeds (Google Postmaster Tools, Yahoo Sender Hub, Microsoft SNDS) and third-party deliverability monitoring tools like Everest, MXToolbox, or similar, and the analytical skill to turn bounce, engagement, and blocklist data into clear recommendations

- Working knowledge of email compliance and acceptable use standards, and comfort having direct conversations with customers who are sending outside of them

- Experience building or improving processes, documentation, or training that help a support or deliverability team scale

- Excellent written and verbal communication, including comfort leading customer calls and simplifying technical concepts for any audience

- Located in the United States or Canada

- Bonus: participation in deliverability communities (M3AAWG, ESPC, or similar) and experience partnering with Customer Success teams

jobs.description:
Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time:

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Seu Cardápio Diário:

O Data Security Specialist é um profissional técnico responsável pela execução e operação dos controles de segurança de dados corporativos e de produção do iFood. Essa posição atua na interseção entre engenharia de segurança, proteção de dados e execução técnica — implementando controles, investigando incidentes e operando as ferramentas que protegem os ativos de dados do iFood.
O Data Security Specialist executa as operações de segurança de dados, impulsiona a adoção de AI nos fluxos de trabalho diários de segurança e garante que as capacidades de proteção de dados acompanhem o crescimento do iFood. É uma posição de contribuidor individual que exige experiência prática comprovada em engenharia de segurança de dados, com capacidade de atuar tanto no ambiente corporativo quanto no de produção.

Segurança de Dados Corporativos

- Operar e evoluir os controles de DLP (Data Loss Prevention) e ZTNA (Zero Trust Network Access) para endpoints, aplicações em cloud e canais de comunicação — implementando políticas, ajustando regras e executando as prioridades trimestrais.

- Implementar e fazer cumprir políticas de classificação de dados e procedimentos de tratamento para usuários internos e terceiros, garantindo alinhamento com LGPD, GDPR e requisitos regulatórios (BACEN, PCI-DSS, entre outros).

- Configurar e manter os controles de segurança para plataformas corporativas de SaaS: Databricks, Salesforce, Google Workspace, outras plataformas e ferramentas emergentes baseadas em AI — estabelecendo baselines de hardening, controles de acesso e governança de configuração.

- Implementar e fazer cumprir políticas de Document Retention & Disposal — estabelecendo cronogramas de retenção, procedimentos de descarte e mecanismos automatizados de aplicação.

- Executar o programa de insider threat: ajustar regras de behavioral analytics, conduzir cadências de análise de anomalias e coordenar com HR e Legal os casos de risco elevado.

- Gerenciar políticas de device posture e a aplicação de ZTNA, garantindo o acesso de dispositivos em conformidade em todo o ambiente corporativo.

Segurança de Dados de Produção

- Conduzir revisões de segurança da arquitetura de dados de produção: avaliar integrações de dados entre sistemas internos, parceiros e clientes, identificando riscos em APIs, pipelines de ETL e padrões de transferência de arquivos.

- Executar o workstream de Data Security no processo de Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), atuando de forma cross-functional com a equipe de IT Risk e contribuindo continuamente para a melhoria dos security review gates, dos requisitos contratuais de segurança e do monitoramento contínuo dos arranjos de troca de dados com terceiros.

- Promover security-by-design nas equipes de engenharia e dados: incorporar requisitos de proteção de dados aos padrões de desenho de integrações, aos frameworks de governança de APIs e aos controles de data residency.

- Garantir que data residency, criptografia em trânsito e em repouso e modelos de controle de acesso atendam às obrigações regulatórias e contratuais em todos os ambientes de produção.

- Apoiar os programas de conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR, PCI-DSS) relacionados à proteção de dados, atuando como ponto de contato técnico de Data Security para as equipes de Legal, Compliance e Audit.

Adoção de AI e Resultados Mensuráveis

- Impulsionar a adoção de AI nos fluxos de trabalho de Data Security: implementar ferramentas de AI para detecção de padrões anômalos de dados, classificação automatizada de dados, ajuste de políticas de DLP e aceleração de investigações — com melhorias mensuráveis na velocidade de detecção, na redução de falsos positivos e na produtividade dos analistas.

- Contribuir para o workstream de Data Security para AI Security, atuando de forma cross-functional com a equipe de AI Security para melhorar continuamente a governança e definir requisitos de proteção de dados para ferramentas de AI, incluindo casos de uso aprovados, tratamento de dados sensíveis em prompts, controles de acesso, monitoramento e padrões de adoção.

- Acompanhar e reportar os resultados impulsionados por AI: quantificar o tempo economizado, os riscos detectados mais cedo e as melhorias na precisão da classificação atribuíveis às ferramentas de AI.

Colaboração Cross-functional e Resposta a Incidentes

- Atuar como referência técnica de Data Security para as equipes adjacentes: traduzir cenários complexos de riscos relacionados a dados em atualizações claras e contextualizadas pelo impacto no negócio para o Data Security Manager e para os times de segurança.

- Construir e manter o dashboard operacional de Data Security: tendências de risco, taxas de violações de políticas, SLAs de remediação, métricas de adoção de AI e status operacional.

- Participar de iniciativas cross-functional de Data Security: coordenar com Legal, Product, Engineering e IT para equilibrar requisitos de segurança e velocidade do negócio — encontrando o caminho seguro que viabilize a entrega de produtos.

- Gerenciar solicitações de exceção de Data Security: avaliar exceções baseadas em risco às políticas de segurança, documentar recomendações e acompanhar o ciclo de vida das exceções.

- Atuar na resposta a incidentes como referência técnica de Data Security: conduzir a frente de investigação específica de dados durante incidentes de grande impacto, coordenar com o CSIRT e comunicar o impacto do risco relacionado a dados ao Data Security Manager.

Operação Técnica de Programas

- Executar o roadmap técnico de Data Security: traduzir as metas estratégicas em tarefas operacionais, gerenciar o acompanhamento de dependências e reportar o progresso ao Data Security Manager.

- Conduzir iniciativas de Sensitive Data Mapping: executar a descoberta, classificação e catalogação cross-functional de dados nos ambientes corporativos e de produção.

- Construir e manter métricas de Data Security: índices de exposição a riscos, tendências de violações de políticas, taxas de encerramento de alertas de DLP, SLAs de remediação e velocidade operacional.

- Documentar e manter runbooks, playbooks e procedimentos operacionais padrão para as operações de Data Security.

Ingredientes Que Buscamos:

- Experiência comprovada como Data Security Specialist, Analyst ou Engineer — com histórico de responsabilidade técnica por um domínio de Data Security.

- Forte experiência em proteção de dados, DLP, ZTNA e governança de segurança da informação.

- Sólida compreensão dos princípios de arquitetura Zero Trust e de sua implementação prática: ZTNA, conditional access, device posture e identity-based segmentation.

- Conhecimento profundo de hardening de segurança de SaaS corporativo: Google Workspace, Salesforce, Databricks, outras plataformas e plataformas emergentes baseadas em AI.

- Conhecimento de conceitos de arquitetura de dados: APIs, pipelines de ETL, data warehouses, plataformas de dados em cloud e padrões de troca de dados de produção.

- Familiaridade com frameworks regulatórios: LGPD, GDPR, PCI-DSS e requisitos regulatórios do BACEN e do PROUF.

- Experiência prática com ferramentas de AI para Data Security: detecção de anomalias, classificação automatizada, ajuste de DLP ou aceleração de investigações — com resultados tangíveis e mensuráveis documentados.

- Sólidas habilidades analíticas e investigativas: capacidade de rastrear um vazamento de dados, desde o sinal até a causa-raiz, e traduzir as descobertas em recomendações sistêmicas.

- Capacidade de colaboração cross-functional: aptidão para conduzir resultados técnicos em colaboração com Legal, Engineering, Product e IT, equilibrando requisitos de segurança e velocidade do negócio.

- Habilidade de documentação e criação de runbooks, playbooks e procedimentos operacionais para Data Security.

- Inglês avançado (obrigatório).

Para Realçar o Sabor:

- Experiência com plataformas SASE (Netskope, Zscaler ou similares) e ferramentas de DSPM (Netskope, Cyera, Wiz ou similares).

- Experiência em data engineering ou analytics — compreensão dos fluxos de dados por dentro, incluindo arquitetura de pipelines, data warehousing e plataformas de dados em tempo real.

- Experiência na adoção de AI em Data Security: implementação de ferramentas de AI para operações de segurança, mensuração de ganhos de produtividade e iteração das estratégias de adoção.

- Certificações: CISM, CDPSE, CISSP ou equivalente.

- Experiência em um setor regulado (fintech, banking, payments, health tech), com exposição prática à conformidade regulatória.

Buscamos uma pessoa apaixonada por segurança em tecnologia, que esteja sempre em busca de novos aprendizados e que goste de desafios. Se você se identifica com este perfil, adoraríamos conhecer você!

Warum wir es tun. Grüner. Fairer. Zukunftsorientierter.

Bei Octopus Electric Vehicles (OEV) Germany gestalten wir die Mobilität der Zukunft direkt am Arbeitsplatz. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die gerne beraten, Verantwortung übernehmen und Freude daran haben, gemeinsam etwas Neues aufzubauen.
Du bist die Verbindung zwischen unseren Firmenkund*innen und ihren Mitarbeitenden. Du berätst Mitarbeitende unserer Partnerunternehmen persönlich und auf Augenhöhe von der ersten Frage zu Elektrofahrzeugen und Ladetechnologie bis hin zur Bestellung. Vertrieb und Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du bringst deine Erfahrungen aus den Beratungsgesprächen ein, um unsere Vertriebsprozesse und Beratungstools für den deutschen Markt kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Wissen teilen und Verantwortung übernehmen: Mit dem Wachstum von OEV kannst du Verantwortung für neue Kolleg*innen übernehmen, dein Wissen über die Bedürfnisse von Firmenmitarbeitenden weitergeben und dabei helfen, unsere B2C-Teams für weiteres Wachstum aufzustellen.

jobs.description:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.
 
Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.

Tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise qui grandit vite, avec beaucoup d’autonomie et une façon assez différente de faire les People Ops ?
Bienvenue chez Octopus Energy France.
Chez nous, nous fonctionnons selon un modèle NoHR : les managers sont le premier point de contact people de leurs équipes. Le rôle de l’équipe People Ops est de leur donner le bon cadre, les bons outils, les bonnes informations et les bons réflexes pour qu’ils puissent être autonomes au quotidien.
Dans ce contexte, nous cherchons aujourd’hui quelqu’un de solide en People Ops, capable à la fois de construire et faire évoluer nos façons de travailler, mais aussi de contribuer concrètement au quotidien de l’équipe.
Le poste est organisé autour de deux grands volets, qui représentent chacun environ 50 % du rôle :
du build : projets People, outils, data, automatisation, IA, amélioration de nos process
du run : administration du personnel, paie, support aux managers et aux équipes, contrôle et fiabilisation des données
Cet équilibre n’est évidemment pas figé : selon les actualités, les projets ou les périodes de l’année, tu pourras passer davantage de temps sur l’un ou l’autre.
Ce qu’on cherche surtout, c’est quelqu’un qui aime construire des choses sans perdre le contact avec l’opérationnel.

1. Build : faire évoluer nos People Ops

Une partie importante de ton rôle sera de prendre en main des projets qui permettent à l’équipe People Ops et aux managers de travailler mieux, plus simplement et plus efficacement.

Tu pourras notamment :

-
piloter des projets People de bout en bout, de l’identification du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

-
simplifier et améliorer nos process

-
construire et faire évoluer notre Help Hub et notre documentation

-
construire des dashboards et des reportings utiles au pilotage : consolider et mieux exploiter les données issues de nos différents outils

-
automatiser certains contrôles, reportings ou tâches répétitives

-
identifier et tester des cas d’usage simples autour de l’IA et de l’automatisation

-
participer à des projets Groupe avec les équipes Octopus basées notamment au Royaume-Uni

-
accompagner les managers dans l’adoption de nouveaux outils ou de nouvelles façons de travailler

On cherche quelqu’un qui aime partir d’un besoin parfois encore un peu flou, le comprendre, le structurer et arriver à une solution concrète.

La data et l’IA sont des outils au service des People Ops et des équipes, pas une fin en soi. Nous ne cherchons donc ni un·e Data Analyst pur, ni un profil tech, mais quelqu’un qui sait s’en servir pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels.

2. Run : contribuer au quotidien de l’équipe

L’autre moitié du poste consiste à être pleinement partie prenante des People Ops du quotidien.

Selon les besoins de l’équipe, tu pourras intervenir sur :

-
l’administration du personnel : contrats, avenants, mouvements, absences, sorties…

-
la préparation et le contrôle de la paie

-
le contrôle et la cohérence des données entre nos différents outils

-
les questions des managers et des salarié·es

-
le suivi et la résolution de sujets opérationnels

-
le support à l’équipe lors des périodes de forte activité ou lorsqu’un sujet urgent apparaît

L’idée n’est pas de te spécialiser dans l’administration ou la paie. En revanche, tu dois être à l’aise pour mettre les mains dedans, comprendre les sujets et apporter du support à l’équipe lorsque c’est nécessaire.

Chez nous, le run est aussi une source importante pour le build : c’est souvent en étant confronté·e aux irritants du quotidien qu’on identifie ce qu’il faut simplifier, automatiser ou repenser.

- tu as au moins 7 ans d’expérience en People Ops, HR Operations ou sur un rôle généraliste avec une forte dimension opérationnelle

-
tu as un très bon niveau d’anglais à l’oral (minimum B2-C1), indispensable pour travailler avec les équipes Octopus à l’international

-
tu as déjà travaillé dans un environnement start-up / scale-up, où il faut savoir naviguer dans l’ambiguïté, s’adapter vite et avancer sans que tout soit parfaitement cadré

-
tu es à l’aise avec le run People Ops : administration du personnel, paie, contrôle de données, support aux managers et aux équipes

-
tu es à l’aise avec la data et sais l’utiliser pour fiabiliser, analyser et mieux piloter

-
tu as déjà piloté des projets People et/ou outils, de la définition du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

-
tu es très à l’aise avec Google Sheets / Excel et, plus largement, avec un environnement de travail digital : Google Workspace, Slack, MacBook…

-
tu es pragmatique : tu cherches des solutions simples, utiles et réellement utilisables

-
tu es autonome, à l’aise dans un environnement qui bouge vite, et capable de prioriser entre projets de fond et sujets opérationnels plus urgents

Pour être transparent, ce poste ne correspondra probablement pas à quelqu’un qui cherche :

-
un poste de Data Analyst / People Analyst pur

-
un rôle uniquement centré sur les projets, sans envie de contribuer au run

-
un poste principalement orienté paie ou administration du personnel

-
un poste purement tech

-
un rôle très stratégique ou de management, éloigné du quotidien des opérations

Nous cherchons quelqu’un de polyvalent et solide en People Ops, qui peut aussi bien passer une matinée à faire avancer un projet outil ou data qu’une après-midi à aider l’équipe sur de la paie, une incohérence de données ou une question manager.

jobs.summary: Chi siamo Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte.
jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
 
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
 
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
 
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 

Il ruolo
In Octopus Energy crediamo che le strutture burocratiche tradizionali rischino spesso di infantilizzare le persone e soffocare la creatività. Le persone adulte non hanno bisogno di rigide regole dall'alto, ma di autonomia, responsabilità e fiducia.
Non cerchiamo un HR tradizionale che imponga processi o "gestisca" le persone per conto dei manager. Cerchiamo una figura di People Operations capace di costruire strumenti e percorsi fluidi (come il nostro onboarding automatizzato) per rimuovere gli ostacoli e dare a ogni team il supporto per esprimersi al meglio fin dal primo giorno.

Gestione Contratti e Onboarding: Redazione e invio dei contratti di lavoro ai nuovi assunti, monitorando con cura lo stato di avanzamento della documentazione necessaria all’ingresso in azienda.

Supporto ai Team Leader: Gestione operativa delle richieste quotidiane, delle segnalazioni e degli aggiornamenti provenienti dai Team Leader.

Anagrafiche e Gestione Sistemi: Mantenimento e aggiornamento costante dei profili dei colleghi sui nostri sistemi gestionali (cambi di ruolo, variazioni contrattuali).

Miglioramento dei Processi & Automazioni: Contributo attivo all’ottimizzazione dei flussi di lavoro, alla creazione/manutenzione di template operativi e all'implementazione di automazioni.

Riservatezza e Cura dei Dati: Garanzia che ogni processo amministrativo e informativo sia gestito con massima cura, precisione e rispetto della riservatezza.

Progetti Amministrativi e Supporto Trasversale: Supporto operativo a progetti speciali o ad altre attività amministrative in base alle esigenze del team.

Ottime capacità comunicative: ottima proprietà di linguaggio sia scritta che orale, fondamentale per interagire con trasparenza con colleghi e stakeholder.

Organizzazione e dettaglio: spiccata attenzione ai dettagli, precisione impeccabile e capacità di organizzare le proprie priorità in modo autonomo.

Serietà e riservatezza: Elevata sensibilità nella gestione di informazioni riservate e dati personali.

Attitudine digitale: familiarità con strumenti digitali, software di gestione del personale o tool di produttività, unita alla capacità di imparare velocemente nuovi sistemi.

Spirito di squadra e proattività: attitudine collaborativa, capacità di anticipare i bisogni e orientamento pratico alla risoluzione dei problemi.

Flessibilità in ambienti dinamici: abilità nel muoversi con disinvoltura in un contesto in rapida crescita, flessibile e privo di burocrazia inutile.

Conoscenza di base di sistemi o procedure paghe (rappresenta un vantaggio apprezzato).

In Octopus fare bene il tuo lavoro è naturale: trovi le condizioni giuste per esprimerti al meglio, perché i tuoi obiettivi, quelli dei colleghi e quelli dell’azienda sono perfettamente allineati. Lavorerai con persone curiose, brillanti e concrete, che hanno voglia di fare bene e migliorare davvero le cose.
Lavorerai per un’azienda che le persone scelgono perché si fidano: abbiamo un servizio clienti valutato 4,9/5 su Trustpilot e premiato da Altroconsumo e dal Corriere della Sera.
Farai parte di una realtà concreta, veloce e poco burocratica, dove contano i risultati, il modo in cui li raggiungiamo e l’impatto che creiamo per i clienti.

Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza.

Equity Options Scheme: in Octopus puoi avere accesso a opzioni su azioni del Gruppo. In pratica, puoi possedere la tua parte di Octopus Energy e partecipare al valore che costruiamo insieme.

Focus sul tuo benessere: ti supportiamo con vantaggi concreti come i buoni pasto e un accesso gratuito a sessioni di benessere psicologico.

Cultura: ogni settimana, il venerdì, ci riuniamo tutti per gli aggiornamenti aziendali e un brindisi. Lo chiamiamo Family Dinner.

Sede: Ancarano/Ascoli Piceno

Ore: Tempo pieno

Presenza in ufficio: Si

OEGen is a specialist energy investment manager overseeing more than £8 billion of assets under management. Our mission is to accelerate the transition to a net zero energy system by investing in clean energy infrastructure and energy transition businesses across multiple jurisdictions.

These businesses are active across Europe and beyond, developing, investing in and managing renewable energy and broader energy transition assets.
This is a strong opportunity for someone with around 4–5 years’ experience who is looking to step into a broader international role and continue developing their technical, commercial and project management capabilities within a growing infrastructure investment environment.

The role will support the Sky Fund’s portfolio and associated holding structures across multiple jurisdictions. You will work closely with investment teams, finance teams, portfolio companies and external advisers on a broad range of tax matters, including tax compliance oversight, reporting, transactions, structuring and ongoing portfolio support.
The position offers wide exposure to international investment structures, cross-border transactions and the full lifecycle of infrastructure investments, while working within a collaborative, hands-on and growing in-house tax team.
